name: spec_to_uvm_with_rtl_observations
description: Recommended order: spec ingest/graph, RTL port extraction and graph, spec interface/register/strategy/testplan (with opt-in RTL observations), then the UVM scaffold behind an owner review gate.

steps.description: Discover and chunk the specification documents.
Extract the port inventory and build the interface JSON from explicit RTL files.
Build the source-backed RTL hierarchy/dependency graph for observations only.
Isolate interface definitions from the specification.
Fetch the register map from the specification.
Build the verification strategy from the spec steps.
Generate the test plan; the RTL graph feeds only the opt-in review-required observations section.
Build the UVM scaffold from the interface JSON and test plan. Owner approval required.

forbidden.title: No RTL behaviour directly into verification code
forbidden.description: uvm_build takes only the built interface JSON (port inventory), the test plan and reviewed agent arguments. RTL graph files, query bundles, excerpts and observation text must never be passed in, neither as arguments nor inside a follow-up prompt. Port lists are wiring facts; expected behaviour stays spec-authoritative.

forbidden.title: RTL observations stay INFERRED and NEEDS_REVIEW
forbidden.description: Implementation observations from the RTL graph are review questions for the RTL design engineer. Nothing in the flow may mark them DOCUMENTED or approved, and no follow-up prompt may ask for that.

forbidden.title: Tools write only under the orchestrator output directory
forbidden.description: Every tool output stays inside --out. Source repositories and RTL inputs are read-only; the orchestrator never modifies design sources.

forbidden.title: Spec steps take no RTL input
forbidden.description: Ingest, graph build, interfaces, registers and strategy run on specifications only. The only RTL input allowed anywhere is the explicit rtl_graph of the testplan observations section.

forbidden.title: The model uses only steps and tools named in the flow
forbidden.description: Overrides may revisit a completed step, skip an optional step, or stop. Invented steps, tools, files or reordering outside this contract are rejected.

forbidden.title: The model skips only optional steps
forbidden.description: Steps without 'optional: true' always run unless the owner intervenes. Skipping them needs human approval, not a model decision.
